encoder: R function .g3_encode_core() is the only implementation; the worker never derives features
integer_only: every feature is an integer; numeric slots are divided by their divisor inside the model

tokens.order: 64 physical squares in canonical order W, N, B, WQ, WK, BQ, BK, each board in local v then u order (square index 1..64, token position index - 1); then 7 board tokens W, N, B, WQ, WK, BQ, BK (positions 64..70); then 1 global token (position 71)

token_categorical.name: board
token_categorical.values: board 1..7 in order W, N, B, WQ, WK, BQ, BK

token_categorical.name: piece
token_categorical.values: 1 empty; 2..7 white P, N, B, R, Q, K; 8..13 black P, N, B, R, Q, K

token_categorical.name: parent
token_categorical.values: 1..3 fixed main board W, N, B; 3 + dock index 1..12 (profile adjacency order) for platforms

token_categorical.name: coord_squares
token_categorical.values: number of physical squares projected to this logical coordinate, capped at 5

token_categorical.name: coord_occupants
token_categorical.values: 1 + occupied physical squares at this logical coordinate, capped at 5

token_categorical.name: en_passant
token_categorical.values: 1 none, 2 en-passant victim, 3 square at the crossed (capture) coordinate

token_categorical.name: controller
token_categorical.values: 1 none (main board, empty or several occupants), 2 single white occupant, 3 single black occupant

token_categorical.name: side
token_categorical.values: 1 white to act, 2 black to act

token_categorical.name: repetition
token_categorical.values: occurrences of the current position key in the repetition record, capped at 3 (lossy summary)

token_numeric.name: repetition_record_scaled
token_numeric.values: length of the repetition record capped at 100 (lossy summary)

candidate_categorical.name: source
candidate_categorical.values: physical square of the moving piece (carried piece; king for castling)

candidate_categorical.name: destination
candidate_categorical.values: physical destination square; for a platform action the carried piece's own square, whose identity is unchanged

candidate_categorical.name: piece
candidate_categorical.values: moving piece, coded as token piece

candidate_categorical.name: captured
candidate_categorical.values: 1 none, otherwise captured piece coded as token piece

candidate_categorical.name: from_dock
candidate_categorical.values: 1 none, otherwise current dock index plus 1

candidate_categorical.name: to_dock
candidate_categorical.values: 1 none, otherwise destination dock index plus 1

candidate_categorical.name: special
candidate_categorical.values: 1 none, 2 pawn double step, 3 en passant

candidate_categorical.name: result_file
candidate_categorical.values: logical file of the moving or carried piece after the action plus 1 (computed by R)

candidate_categorical.name: result_rank
candidate_categorical.values: logical rank of the moving or carried piece after the action plus 1 (computed by R)

candidate_categorical.name: destination_board
candidate_categorical.values: board 1..7 of the destination physical square

candidate_numeric.name: file_displacement
candidate_numeric.values: signed logical file change of the moving or carried piece

candidate_numeric.name: rank_displacement
candidate_numeric.values: signed logical rank change of the moving or carried piece

candidates.order: canonical legal-action order of the R engine (sorted by action id)
candidates.truncation: never; batches pad to the largest candidate count with a boolean mask
candidates.digest: SHA-256 of the action ids joined by a newline character
candidates.gather: the scorer gathers contextual embeddings at token positions source - 1, destination - 1 and 63 + destination_board, plus the global token and the mean of all tokens

outputs.logits: one logit per real candidate, in candidate order
outputs.wdl: three logits in the order win, draw, loss from the side to act
outputs.value: p_win - p_loss in [-1, 1] from the side to act
outputs.expected_score: p_win + 0.5 * p_draw in [0, 1] from the side to act
outputs.aux_heuristic: separately named auxiliary scalar (tanh) trained on normalised search heuristics; not calibrated WDL

lossy: repetition and repetition_record_scaled summarise the history; exact draw adjudication stays with the R engine
